defect: A newly constructed adapter snapshots current parameters, then accepts a structurally valid but stale HybridFactualState from a previous model generation because factual state carries no provenance
hypothesis: Tag every generated/cold-restored factual state with a stable cryptographic content digest of its source model state_dict and TTT eta; new adapter validates tag against its own exact source weight digest alongside existing live parameter revision guard

design.provenance: SHA256 sorted state_dict key+dtype+shape+raw tensor bytes plus TTT eta
design.cold_restorable: same weights and eta restore preserves identity; after model edit/retrain old state must fail closed
design.legacy: untagged four-field state rejected; cold restore contract updated to persist tag
design.scope: original model and forward code unchanged; no original research first-use; no new trainable weights

frozen_negative_controls: same-model old state remains usable until model revision
cross-adapter stale state after changed weights MUST reject before any cached read
adapter from different same-shaped random weight seed MUST reject foreign state
cold restore with exactly matching weights and eta must match preview bitwise
missing provenance tag on manually restored legacy state must reject
head or stem optimizer update invalidates old state under both old and fresh adapters
TTT eta difference invalidates old state
fresh adapter after update accepts only state initialized and factually confirmed under new weights
all unchanged ancestor P62-S P64-S and P64K R1/R2 focused tests pass on exact candidate
40/60-event CPU engineering timing and numeric parity remain within previously pinned bounds
no full original Windows/Linux/GPU/official science acceptance claim without exact final-source owner qualification
limits: digest is provenance tag, not MAC or authenticity proof; caller may forge string and tensor bytes
direct untracked .data alias writes after adapter construction may bypass PyTorch _version
extra setup costs/time are not included in historical local benchmark
old untagged saved states require explicit re-confirmation or trusted provenance migration
